summary.name: Prosody IM
summary.one_liner: Prosody is a modern Jabber/XMPP communication server written in Lua, designed to be easy to set up and light on system resources.
use_cases: set up family and friends chat
link servers into an open XMPP network
summary.what_it_does: Prosody is an XMPP (Jabber) communication server written in Lua. It aims to be easy to set up and configure, and efficient with system resources. It is built to be extended, giving developers a flexible system for adding functionality or prototyping new protocols. It can federate with other Prosody installations and other XMPP-compatible services, and it supports a wide range of desktop and mobile XMPP clients. The project is open source under the MIT/X11 license.
notable: Written in Lua and designed for low resource use
Extensible architecture for developers and protocol prototyping
Federates with other Prosody and XMPP servers
caveats: Page does not state supported server operating systems
Page does not describe hosting or paid tiers
